A hunting bow is a ranged weapon that can be found within various missions. Its unique variants are the master's bow, the hunter's promise, and the ancient bow.

Obtaining

Missions

Listed difficulties are considered to be the minimum difficulty the item is obtainable on unless stated otherwise.

  • Soggy Swamp
  • Soggy Cave
  • Panda Plateau (DLC)
  • Nether Fortress (DLC)
  • End Wilds (DLC)
  • Tower

Merchants

  • Village Merchant
  • Gift Wrapper
  • Mystery Merchant
  • Luxury Merchant
  • Piglin Merchant

Ancients

  • The Tower (mob)

Usage

When the hero hits a mob with a hunting bow, any pets they summoned with an artifact attack the targeted mob.

Properties

  • X ranged damage
  • Pets attack targeted mobs

Stats

  • Multiplier: 1-2
  • Quiver: 53

Data values

  • Hunting bows use two internal, hidden enchantments.
    • The first one, HuntingBowEnchantment, is used by the game to make companions attack targeted mobs.
    • The second one, HuntingBowTaggedEnchantment, is used by the game to apply a target over the head of any mob struck with an arrow.
